topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I always thought cities were vast, sprawling things, where the odds of running into someone twice, let alone knowing them, felt as rare as a clear night sky in the midst of a city's glow. But here it is, a thread connecting us, my online friend and I, in the same streets, maybe even the same paths. The world feels suddenly smaller, more confined. I find myself looking over my shoulder, wondering if I’ve already seen them, if they’ve seen me, how this changes everything. The熟悉感带来了不安，但我不确定这种感觉从何而来。Every corner now seems a little closer, a little more personal, and the idea of coincidences starts to feel like a thin veil, barely covering a web of connections I never fully understood.
